description: Expose an extra port on a specific instance (by id or exact name). Use this when the server listens on a port players cannot reach, such as a mod, a voice server, or a web map. The server picks the next free public port in the instance's block; you choose only the internal port the game listens on. Game-required ports are already mapped automatically, so check get_connection_info first. Port mappings apply to shared-IP servers only.

confirm.description: Must be true. Set this only after showing the user exactly what will be added (the server will expose an extra public port) and getting their approval.

container.description: The internal port the game or service listens on, 1024-65535.

description.description: Longer note about what the port is for, shown in the panel.

instance.description: Instance id (preferred) or exact instance name.

name.description: Short label for the mapping, shown in the panel, e.g. "Voice Chat".

name: add_port
title: Add Port Mapping
